title: T1 beat Karmine Corp 3-1 to reach sixth straight Worlds semi-final against Bilibili Gaming

title: The MongolZ end FURIA’s winning run as NAVI send Falcons out of IEM Beijing
summary:

title: KRÜ Blaze win Game Changers Championship from lower bracket, ending Gentle Mates’ unbeaten run
summary:
